svg.title: Taste: the salt rings around food
svg.desc: The salt one orb leaches into the floor beneath it, in a 42 m window of 2 m cells, after 1, 10 and 60 minutes and 10 minutes after it is eaten, from the world's own floor field (solutes.rs), a second orb's salt beside it: it spreads within its terrace, never across a riser (cyan), and fades once the orb is gone.
svg.text: Taste: the salt rings around food
Salt on the floor around orb 1, one 2 m cell per square, coloured over three decades below the salt under it at 60 min. A minute spreads it 2.79 m (2 sqrt(D t)).
Orb drawn 4x its size. Leach 1 unit/s, fade 5e-4 /s: chosen world settings, not measured (solutes.rs).
